name: Add a website and retain it after refresh
description: Verifies an authenticated user can add a website and see the saved details after reopening the dashboard.
steps: Add a website named Sample Portfolio with domain sample.example and provider Cloudflare Pages
expected: Sample Portfolio appears in the website list with its domain and hosting provider.

name: Edit a saved website
description: Verifies a saved website can be edited and its updated status and provider are shown.
steps: Sign in and create a website named Edit Me
Change the provider to GitHub Pages and status to Live
expected: The website card shows GitHub Pages and a Live status.

name: Delete a website only after confirmation
description: Verifies deleting a dashboard record requires confirmation and remains deleted after refresh without affecting an external website.
steps: Sign in and create a website named Remove Me
Choose Keep it and verify the card remains
Open delete again and confirm Delete project
expected: Remove Me is absent from the dashboard after refresh.

name: Validate required project name on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile add-project form blocks an empty name.
steps: Sign in and open Add website
expected: The browser shows required-field validation and no project is added.
